1. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are __proofs of claim forms and supporting documentation__;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations __and wherein the generating step includes validating the data records__; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations __by aggregating the bankruptcy documents and filing them in batch mode at least once per day__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations __and wherein the batch filing is performed by a server computer__.

6. (Currently amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim __and wherein the proofs of claims include proof of claim forms and supporting documentation__;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations __and wherein the generating step includes validating the data records__; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations __by aggregating the proofs of claims and filing them in batch mode at least once per day__.

7. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations __and wherein the batch filing is performed by a server computer__.

8. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors __of specific debtors that have filed for bankruptcy and the status of filed proofs of claims__.

9. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using __a secure encrypted connection with authentication and handshaking protocols__.

10. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via __a secure Web site with authentication requirements__.

11. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode __at least once per day, wherein the batch filing is triggered by a scheduled time interval__.

12. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report __specific to a particular creditor__; and
sending the report to a particular creditor __via a secure transmission__.

13. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site __with user authentication__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed __and the status of pending filings__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim __and storing the receipt in association with the creditor's account__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer __that aggregates data from multiple creditors before filing__.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record __to ensure compliance with the filing requirements of each different bankruptcy organization__.
